summary: Budget Board is a self-hosted application designed for recording monthly expenses and monitoring progress toward personal monetary targets. It addresses the common requirement for private financial bookkeeping without relying on third-party cloud services. The project is distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want to take direct control of their personal finance data on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: With a modest community following and moderate development activity, you may encounter fewer community resources and plugins compared to larger alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes to prevent data loss on container restart, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
